subject: Release coordination: Safe apply + rollback (runtime + control plane + Console sequencing)
body:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 1, 2026 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Release coordination: Safe apply + rollback (runtime + control plane + Console sequencing)
Attachments: Safe-Apply-Rollback-Release-Checklist_v3.pdf; ReleaseTrain_2026.02_notes.txt

Team — pulling together sequencing for the Safe apply + rollback launch (control plane + runtime + Console) so we don’t end up with a partially-shipped experience.

Proposal (needs your +1 / changes):

1) Control plane + API first (ship behind feature flags)
- Config versioning + diff/validation APIs (redwood/pr-19834, pr-19857, pr-19888)
- Rollback endpoint + semantics (redwood/pr-19902)
- Audit events emitted for lifecycle actions (redwood/pr-19941)

2) Runtime apply pipeline next
- Transaction/checkpoint apply (redwood/pr-19915)
- Idempotent applier + retry safety (redwood/pr-19918)
- Canary controller hooks + pause/resume (redwood/pr-19991)

3) Console last (but must not expose rollback until (1)+(2)+RBAC are live)
- Backend rollback trigger + server-side confirmations/cooldowns (redwood/pr-19952)
- History timeline API (redwood/pr-19960)

4) RBAC + audit sign-off gating
- RBAC policy bundle updates required before enabling flags for any non-internal accounts (rbac-policy-bundle/pr-20070)
- Security: confirm audit payload fields are final for SIEM export (taxonomized events)

Backport question for Feb release train:
- We can backport (1) + (2) into 2026.02 if we keep Console hidden and default gates conservative.
- If we miss runtime idempotency + race fixes, I’d prefer we do NOT backport rollback at all (only ship versioning + validation).

Asks:
- Ava: do you want to treat this as a formal go/no-go gate with Security sign-off before we flip any customer-facing flags?
- Marissa: confirm Console plan: ship UI in dark mode, only enable for internal beta + selected Hosted/Dedicated accounts.
- Aisha: are there any must-have audit/RBAC items that block the backport (even if flags remain off)?

Timing (tentative):
- 2026.02 train cutoff: Feb 6
- Internal enablement: week of Feb 9
- Limited GA (selected accounts): late Feb / early Mar

Connor
Release Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference


---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 1, 2026 at 10:01 AM PT
Subject: Re: Release coordination: Safe apply + rollback (runtime + control plane + Console sequencing)

Agree w/ sequencing. Strong preference: Console shows NOTHING for customers unless rollback is real and gated.

Console plan from my side:
- Ship the history view + diff view behind “opt_config_history_ui” flag (internal-only initially).
- Rollback button behind separate “opt_config_rollback_ui” flag; only enabled when:
  (a) RBAC bundle is deployed
  (b) audit events are live
  (c) runtime idempotency + rollback semantics are verified in internal gameday

We also need comms:
- Support enablement doc (how to identify active config version, where to look in Console)
- Release notes snippet for limited GA accounts (non-marketing; just “what changed + how to rollback”).

Re: backport — OK backporting versioning + validation even if UI stays dark.

Marissa
Director of Product


---

From: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 1, 2026 at 10:27 AM PT
Subject: Re: Release coordination: Safe apply + rollback (runtime + control plane + Console sequencing)

Security POV:

1) Audit logging is not optional for rollback.
- If rollback endpoint is present (even behind flags), we need the event emitted and tested end-to-end.
- Required fields (minimum): actor, actor_type, tenant_id, scope (model/region), from_version, to_version, request_id, result, timestamp.

2) RBAC requirements:
- Must ensure “optimization change operator” is the only role that can apply/promote/rollback.
- Read-only access for auditors/support is fine, but rollback MUST be denied absent explicit permission.

3) Backport position:
- OK to backport control-plane versioning + validation.
- NOT OK to backport rollback endpoint without audit events + RBAC bundle shipped in the same train.

If you want, I can assign Kevin (audit export) to run a quick validation against our SIEM payload expectations once we have a staging log sample.

Aisha
CISO
Redwood Inference


---

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 1, 2026 at 11:06 AM PT
Subject: Re: Release coordination: Safe apply + rollback (runtime + control plane + Console sequencing)

Yes: treat as formal go/no-go.

Decision criteria (keep it simple):
- Runtime: idempotent applier verified + rollback doesn’t leave mixed worker state in gameday.
- Security: audit + RBAC validated in staging.
- Product: Console still dark until the above are green.

Connor — can you add a single checklist owners column and “evidence link” column? I want to be able to open one doc and see what is actually done vs “done-ish.”

Also, I’d like the limited GA target accounts list (even if rough) before we flip anything. We should be explicit about who is in the first wave.

Ava
VP, Engineering


---

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 1, 2026 at 2:14 PM PT
Subject: Re: Release coordination: Safe apply + rollback (runtime + control plane + Console sequencing)

Got it.

Updates / concrete plan:

Backport decision (2026.02):
- Backport: config versioning + validation/diff APIs + audit event emission plumbing.
- Conditional backport: rollback endpoint ONLY if rbac-policy-bundle/pr-20070 merges by Wed and we can prove the full event payload in staging.
- Runtime apply transaction + idempotency: must land in the train (pr-19915 + pr-19918). If either slips, rollback endpoint will be held.

Console:
- Ship Console backend endpoints as dark (no UI flags enabled).
- UI flags stay off for all customers in 2026.02; internal-only enablement after cutoff.

Go/no-go artifact:
- I’ll revise the attached checklist w/ owner + evidence link column and circulate tonight.

Limited GA accounts list:
- Will come from Marissa + Sales, but initial suggestion is 3–5 Hosted accounts + 1 Dedicated account where we already have strong oncall coverage.

One open risk: race condition bugfix (redwood/pr-20111) isn’t in the original list but runtime team said it may be needed. If it’s required, we should include it in the “must land for rollback” set.

Connor


---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 2, 2026 at 11:03 AM PT
Subject: Re: Release coordination: Safe apply + rollback (runtime + control plane + Console sequencing)

Confirmed.

On limited GA accounts list: I’ll sync with Sales today and send a shortlist by EOD. Criteria:
- customer has asked for rollback/audit trail explicitly
- willing to be on “limited GA” terms (feature flags, monitored rollout)
- agrees to a canary requirement for any quant profile changes

Also: please ensure release notes for 2026.02 do NOT mention “one-click rollback” publicly if UI is dark. We can phrase as “optimization config versioning + safer rollout primitives” and keep rollback as “available to select accounts.”

Marissa
